purpose: Teach: 公司/至上/共和党/政務次官/古来/有事/必至/参院

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、中国公司との合弁を検討しろ
lines.en: I want you to explore a joint venture with a Chinese company.
lines.style: Crisp, declarative. Clipped delivery on each phrase. Authority without theatricality. The tone of someone used to being heard and obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様第一を至上の理念とします
lines.en: Understood. We'll make customer-first thinking our guiding principle.
lines.style: Measured, obedient cadence. Slight pause before each commitment, as if noting it down internally. Respectful but not servile—professional acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、米国共和党系の業界団体とも交流しろ
lines.en: And establish ties with Republican-leaning industry groups in the United States.
lines.style: Steady instruction, continuing the earlier thread. No inflection for drama—just another strategic mandate. Expectation of compliance embedded in the flatness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。元政務次官をアドバイザーに招きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll bring on a former deputy minister as an advisor.
lines.style: Quick, efficient response. Minimal words—showing he's already thinking three steps ahead. Slight uptick at the end, signaling readiness for the next directive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、古来の日本文化を商品に取り入れろ
lines.en: Make traditional Japanese culture a core part of our product offering.
lines.style: Same measured authority as before. Weight on 'traditional'—this matters strategically, not sentimentally. Unhurried but absolute.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。有事の事業継続計画を整備します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also prepare our business continuity plans for emergencies.
lines.style: Professional affirmation, slightly faster than before. Showing initiative—he's anticipated and is already moving. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、デジタル化は必至だ
lines.en: Digitalization is now inevitable for us.
lines.style: Firm conviction. Slight emphasis on 'inevitable'—this isn't a suggestion, it's a fact he's stating. Final-sounding, like a conclusion reached after thought.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。参院選挙に向けた対外発信も準備します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also coordinate our external messaging ahead of the Upper House elections.
lines.style: Clipped acceptance, moving faster now. Understands the meeting is ending. Shows he's tracking both explicit and implicit tasks. Last line—slight closure in the breath.
